_comment: Per-language TTS for xuefeng (Xuefeng: proud, bratty). flow.director/flow.live --tts auto; flags win. ja chosen by ear on the server engine: 櫻歌ミコ/第二形態 (id 44 there). 櫻歌ミコ has no emotional style (ノーマル 43, 第二形態 44, ロリ 45), so every mood speaks in 第二形態 with AudioQuery offsets (speech.VOICEVOX_MOODS; override per mood here as {"speed": 1.1, "pitch": 0.03, "intonation": 1.3, "volume": 1.0}). en/zh edge voices and rates are guesses, to be chosen by ear. Credit 'VOICEVOX:櫻歌ミコ' when publishing the audio.
